title: Low-stock report
expected_route: small clear feature: tdd, no spec or grill needed
instruction: Purchasing wants a low-stock report. Add lowStockReport(products, inventory, threshold) to src/inventory.mjs. It returns [{ id, name, available }] for every product whose available stock (stock minus reservations) is at or below threshold, sorted by available ascending, then by id. threshold must be a non-negative integer; anything else throws a RangeError.
